decisions.reason: As a close extension of the hosting and web project business, the template is easy to justify as part of the broader offer, and in a growing firm with many related services management is likely to keep it despite only modest visible commitment.

The responsive website template fits the firm's existing customer base and service logic, so even with limited public prominence management is likely to continue it rather than admit an early reversal.

Premium customer support is highly central to the firm's stated strategy of expert service and tailored support, making withdrawal unlikely because management has strong strategic and reputational reasons to persist.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical platform and R&D direction, and its dedicated web page signals visible commitment that encourages continuation.

Although more distant from the core offer, the dedicated page and multiple-model product line suggest meaningful investment and public commitment, which under escalation of commitment makes management inclined to give it more time.
